title: Looking back on Microsoft’s FY26: From AI experimentation to Frontier Transformation
summary: Throughout this past fiscal year, customers across every industry and segment moved from AI experimentation to deploying AI for real-world business outcomes. They unlocked innovation and created new opportunities for growth. We saw the emergence of Frontier Firms as they moved beyond efficiency gains to focus on human ambition and embed AI at the core...
